messages:
Evan R: heads up - Felixa (AM: @felixa-lead) wants us to onboard a customer-finetuned 13B into Private. Requirements: PHI-safe, model-locking (no auto-updates), audit trail per inference, pilot for 10 days, target p95 ~150ms on A10G. They will upload weights.
Maya S: do we know if weights are quantized? also ask if they want us to host or do BYO-hosting.
Evan R: they said BYO checkpoint upload and expect Redwood to host it in their VPC. Not quantized.
Kai H: ok. plan: 1) security intake + DPA addendum 2) artifact integrity + provenance checks 3) quantization pass (int4/int8) + quality regression eval 4) perf run on A10G batch=1 and adaptive batching 5) canary + pilot 10d with rollback playbook.
Maya S: perf risk note: 150ms p95 on A10G for 13B at batch=1 is optimistic. we'll measure; fallback options: int8 or seq cap.
LegalBot: DPA addendum required for PHI plus written confirmation of log redaction rules. I'll draft and loop in AM for signature.
Evan R: customer also asked for an estimate of incremental ops cost (GPU-hours + storage + pilot monitoring). Can someone prep a short delta for Thurs sync?
Kai H: I'll run a quick GPU-hour estimate and perf bench after we receive weights. ETA: 3 business days for bench + quantization report once artifacts arrive.
OnboardBot: Ticket created: CS-4107 7 Felixa 13B Private Onboard (link: https://internal.redwood.ai/sops/onboard/CS-4107) :white_check_mark:
Maya S: deliverables before pilot: security intake complete, weights uploaded + checksum, quantization report & quality deltas, perf report on declared infra, canary + rollback runbook, cost delta note.
Evan R: scheduled intro sync Fri 10am PT with Felixa infra. I'll add agenda and request a small redacted prompt set to run initial evals.
Kai H: noted. I'll post preliminary cost/perf numbers in the thread after unpack.
Maya S: tagging renewal risk: medium-high if onboarding delays extend beyond pilot window. put AM on weekly updates.
Evan R: thanks all, will follow up after Fri call. :wave:
